content: Namo ratnatrayāyaNama Aryajñānasāgaravairocanavyūharājāya tathāgatayaNamaḥ sarvatathagatebhyaḥ arhadbhyaḥ samyaksambuddhebhyaḥ Nama āryāvalokitesvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya Tadyathā - oṃ dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru eṭṭe vaṭṭe cale cale Pracale pracale kusume kusumavare ili mili citijvalamapanaye svāhā
